covered.label: National Rail
covered.detail: Every train calling at Waterloo, Victoria, London Bridge, Liverpool Street, King's Cross, St Pancras and Paddington, from the UK's national real-time feed.

notCovered.label: Eurostar
notCovered.detail: Excluded at St Pancras International — it needs border check-in, unlike a walk-up domestic train.

notCovered.label: Night Riviera Sleeper
notCovered.detail: Excluded at Paddington — booking a berth is compulsory.

notCovered.label: London Underground, DLR, Overground and buses
notCovered.detail: Not covered here — see the separate London (TfL) region.

stations: 571 stations and stops: 571 National Rail stations across London, Kent, Surrey, Sussex and Essex's National Rail commuter network (530 from the 14 Sep 2026 UK station fill, phase 2a; 41 more — 38 Kent, 3 Surrey — reassigned in from rest-of-england 15 Sep 2026 round 2, docs/jim-brief-rest-of-england-reassignment.md). This pack's own Essex scope is its Fenchurch Street/c2c corridor and Liverpool Street suburban stations (Rainham, Grays, Upminster, Brentwood and the like) — the Essex market towns further out on Greater Anglia's own lines (Chelmsford, Clacton-on-Sea, Harlow and others) resolved to greater-anglia 15 Sep 2026, not here (docs/jim-brief-essex-to-greater-anglia.md, docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md section 2). Elizabeth line-exclusive/London Overground-exclusive stations (Bond Street, Canary Wharf, Custom House, Tottenham Court Road, Woolwich Elizabeth line platforms, Barking Riverside) are not catalogued here — they are uk-london-tfl's per docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md.
notes: This region is National Rail only. For the Underground, Elizabeth line, DLR, Overground and Tram, see the London region.
